_readme: A BATCH IS DATA. No code lives in this file and none may. The grids below are laid out exactly like the photograph: three rows of three, reading left to right. Where a print sits in the array IS where it sits on the sheet, so there are no position numbers to get wrong. Full instructions: brain-config/hooks/batch-import.md
label: Sheet 4 · Ice Cream
source: Two photographs, 2026-07-31. Front/back NOT determined - the sheet was shot loose and neither photo shows which physical face is which. Arrival order was deliberately NOT used as evidence (that is the assumption that was wrong on the Drinks sheet, 07-30).

ninja-turtle.name: Ninja Turtle
ninja-turtle.notes: A green turtle-face character bar on a wooden stick, red mask, two dark gumball eyes. Signed AI.

rocket-pop.notes: A red, white and blue layered rocket popsicle on a stick. Signed AI.
